lines.t: I’ve been fightin’ hard for what won’t stay,
Clingin’ to things that will fade away.
But You said, “Let go, give up, be broken,”
Now I’m learnin’ to trust and obey.
I want to be destroyed in Your love, Lord,
Burned clean by the flame from above.
Strip me down till the gold shines through,
I want to be made more like You.
[Verse 2]
“I am enough,” that’s what You said,
Your truth keeps ringin’ in my head.
When I stop tryin’ to stand so tall,
Your grace is more than enough for all.
I want to be destroyed in Your love, Lord,
Burned clean by the flame from above.
Strip me down till the gold shines through,
I want to be made more like You.
You laid it all down, every breath, every drop,
Love so strong it would never stop.
So here I am, Lord, heart in Your hands,
Do what You will, I’ll trust Your plans.
I want to be destroyed in Your love, Lord,
Till only pure faith remains.
Take all I am, let the old man die,
And raise me to life again.
(Tag)
Destroyed in Your love… made new again.
